scenes.text: Skinny-fat? Stop fucking bulking. Seriously, just stop.
Eating every fucking thing in sight won't build muscle. It just stacks on more fat.
Lift heavy as fuck, three to four times a week. Bench, rows, squats, presses. Push every set.
Eat high-protein meals. Chicken, eggs, fish, yogurt. Stay in a small fucking deficit.
Lose the fat. Build the fucking muscle. Do both at the same damn time.

caption: Skinny-fat? Stop bulking. Lose fat and build muscle at the same time: lift 3-4x a week, eat enough protein, and keep a small calorie deficit. Save this for your next gym day.
